notes: Run each eval in a small throwaway repo. Check the written archie/<plan-slug>/ folder (STATUS.md, archie-plan.md, done/) and archie/INDEX.md.

evals.setup: Python repo with a CLI, no tests, README with outdated usage.
evals.prompt: archie: add a --json flag to the CLI, add tests, and update the README.
evals.expected_output: Plan with scored tasks, README edit scored jr, tests scored eng, each with pass/fail criteria and gotchas; status in STATUS.md.
expectations: Every task spec lists score, level, tier, executor, depends, pass, fail and gotchas, and has no Status line
STATUS.md has one row per task with its status, and is under 4 KB
README update is scored 1-2 and tier light
Levels follow 1-2 jr, 2.5-3 eng, 3.5-4 sr, 4.5-5 ar
No task scored above 3 has a subagent executor
Plan header shows the audit result from max tier
Plan contains a Questions for Prompter table with a default per question
Plan is written to archie/<plan-slug>/archie-plan.md, not to the workspace root
archie/INDEX.md has a row for the plan and archie/ROUTING.md holds the tier mapping

evals.setup: Host exposes exactly two models, one cheap and one capable.
evals.prompt: archie: plan a refactor of the auth module into a service.
evals.expected_output: Tiers collapse upward onto the two models; architecture decision scored 4.5-5 stays on the main agent.
expectations: archie/ROUTING.md maps light and standard to the cheaper model and strong and max to the better one
Service boundary design is scored ar and executed by the main agent
No vendor or model name appears outside archie/ROUTING.md or a plan's tier override

evals.setup: Plan exists; an eng-level task failed its Pass criteria once with a subagent.
evals.expected_output: Failed task is re-run one tier up with score +1 and the failure in gotchas; a second failure marks it blocked.
expectations: Task re-run on the next tier, not the same tier
Score raised by 1 and failure appended to Gotchas
After a second failure the STATUS.md row is blocked and the prompter is asked
Does not loop at the same tier

evals.setup: Unknown repo with unknown test command and package manager.
evals.prompt: archie: plan adding retry logic to the HTTP client.
evals.expected_output: Asks test command, package manager and off-limits files in one batched question table instead of running discovery commands first.
expectations: Questions batched in one message with proposed defaults
Does not run multiple exploratory commands to find the test runner
Unanswered questions proceed on the default and are marked assumed

evals.setup: Repo with three independent modules a, b, c and a shared config.py.
evals.prompt: archie: add a docstring pass to modules a, b, c, then update config.py and run the full test suite.
evals.expected_output: Docstring tasks share wave 1 and run concurrently on light/standard subagents; config edit and test run follow in later waves.
expectations: Plan has a Waves line and each task has Wave and Parallel fields
The three module tasks are in the same wave with Parallel: yes
Subagents for the wave are launched in one batch, not sequentially
Test-suite task is in a later wave than every task it depends on
No two same-wave tasks write the same file
Concurrent subagents do not exceed the stated limit (default 4)
Only the main agent writes STATUS.md

evals.setup: archie/ has INDEX.md and ten plan folders; one plan 'api' is active with tasks T1-T3 done (in done/wave-1.md) and T4 open; the others are done.
evals.prompt: archie: what's next on the api plan? Then do it.
evals.expected_output: Reads INDEX.md and archie/api/STATUS.md, then only T4's spec; does not open other plans or done/.
expectations: Reads archie/INDEX.md before any plan file
Does not open archie-plan.md of the nine done plans
Does not read archie/api/done/ unless T4 needs history, and then searches it rather than reading it whole
After T4 passes, its block is in done/wave-N.md with a Result line, a stub remains in archie-plan.md, and STATUS.md and INDEX.md are updated

evals.setup: Git repo; work runs on branch feat-x in a worktree; plan archie/x/ exists on main.
evals.expected_output: Status change is a small status-only commit on main; the moved task block travels with feat-x.
expectations: STATUS.md and INDEX.md changes are committed on the default branch, not only on feat-x
The T2 block move to done/ is committed on feat-x
If committing to main is not allowed, the report says so instead of keeping status only on the branch

evals.setup: Older plan with Status: lines in each task, no STATUS.md, a 15 KB Progress section; some tasks done, some open.
evals.prompt: archie: migrate this plan to the new layout.
evals.expected_output: STATUS.md built from task headings and checked; done blocks and the Progress section moved to done/; open specs remain.
expectations: STATUS.md lists every task id, with statuses from the ROUTING.md vocabulary only (no 'partly done')
Done task blocks are in done/wave-N.md with stubs left in archie-plan.md
The Progress section is in done/log.md, newest first
No Status: lines remain in archie-plan.md task specs
The folder and archie-plan.md name are unchanged so existing links still work
